name: List Artifact — DDD + Event-Sourcing + CQRS Internal Architecture
description: Internal architecture of the @alistigo/artifact-list reference implementation. Uses DDD hexagonal layering (pattern: ddd-hexagonal) + Event Sourcing + CQRS (pattern: event-sourcing-cqrs). The domain is pure; state changes are captured as immutable events; the current document is a projection.

nodes.name: list-domain (@alistigo/list-domain)
nodes.description: PURE domain layer. Entities: List, ListItem. Value objects: ListId, ItemId, ActionStatus. Domain event types (ListCreated, ItemAdded, ItemToggled, ItemRemoved, ListRenamed) and command types. Zero project-internal imports. No IO, no DOM.

nodes.name: list-document-format (@alistigo/list-document-format)
nodes.description: PURE document format layer. JSON Schema for the document and events, TypeScript types (Document, Event, Command), parse(), validate(), serialize() functions. JSON-LD + schema.org foundation (ADR 0026). The single source of truth for the wire format.

interfaces.name: JSON Schema
interfaces.description: JSON Schema Draft 2020-12 for AlistigoDocument and AlistigoEvent

nodes.name: list-document-editor (@alistigo/list-document-editor)
nodes.description: Application layer. Command handlers (AddItem, ToggleItem, RemoveItem, RenameList) validate commands and emit events. Projector: reduce(events, initial) → Document. Queries: LoadCurrentDocument, ExportDocument. Declares ports as TypeScript interfaces. Imports list-domain and list-document-format only.

nodes.name: Ports (declared in list-document-editor)
nodes.description: Port interfaces owned by the Application layer. EventStore: append(events)/readAll()/readSince(seq). SnapshotStore: load()/save() (optional, M2+). DocumentSerializer: parse()/stringify(). DocumentValidator: validate(). EventValidator: validate(). HostBridge: send()/on() (M5+).

nodes.name: LocalStorageEventStore (Adapter)
nodes.description: Implements EventStore port using browser localStorage. Keys: alistigo:evt:<list-id>:<seq>. Used in the browser iframe at runtime (M1/M2).

nodes.name: ClaudeStorageEventStore (Adapter)
nodes.description: Implements EventStore port using window.storage (Claude artifact context, ADR 0005). Wraps claude-storage-plugin. Used when running inside Claude.ai.

nodes.name: InMemoryEventStore (Adapter)
nodes.description: Implements EventStore port in-memory. Used by the Gherkin runner and unit tests. No IO.

nodes.name: JsonLdSerializer (Adapter)
nodes.description: Implements DocumentSerializer port. Delegates to list-document-format package for JSON-LD parsing and stringification.

nodes.name: AjvValidator (Adapter)
nodes.description: Implements DocumentValidator and EventValidator ports using Ajv 2020. Validates against JSON Schemas from list-document-format package.

nodes.name: PostMessageHostBridge (Adapter, M5+)
nodes.description: Implements HostBridge port. Handles postMessage communication with the embedding host. Origin validation, schema validation on every payload. Message types: alistigo:config, alistigo:event, alistigo:replay, alistigo:snapshot, alistigo:emitted.

interfaces.name: postMessage protocol
interfaces.description: Versioned postMessage envelope. Defined in packages/alistigo-host-protocol/

nodes.name: list-components-react (@alistigo/list-components-react)
nodes.description: Presentation layer. React components for the list UI (Storybook). No domain logic. Dispatches commands to Application. Subscribes to Application state via Preact Signals.

interfaces.name: React Components
interfaces.description: ListApp, ListItem, CheckboxItem, etc. — presentational only

nodes.name: artifact-list (@alistigo/artifact-list)
nodes.description: The assembled artifact UMD bundle. Wires all layers together at boot: resolves the config document, selects the correct storage adapter, initialises Application layer, mounts the React presentation. Shipped via npm and served via jsDelivr.

nodes.name: artifact-list-skill (@alistigo/artifact-list-skill)
nodes.description: AI agent skill for the list artifact. Contains SKILL.md and api.json (AgentSkills.io standard, ADR 0015). Teaches Claude how to produce list documents and issue commands.

interfaces.name: SKILL.md
interfaces.description: Machine-readable skill specification for Claude Code and other AI agents

nodes.name: Event Log
nodes.description: Append-only log of domain events persisted to browser storage. The single source of truth at runtime. Keys: alistigo:evt:<list-id>:<seq>. The document is always re-derivable from this log.

nodes.name: list-features-runner-playwright
nodes.description: Gherkin runner for list artifact. Drives list-document-editor command/query API directly (Application-level, not DOM) for fast deterministic feedback. Playwright bridge for E2E UI smoke tests. ADR: TDD via Gherkin constraint (C6).
